items.name: hero-01
items.title: Hero — Centered
items.description: Centered hero with badge, heading, description, and dual CTA buttons.
items.author: SAASTRO <https://saastro.io>
items.docs: Import: `import { Hero01 } from '@/components/blocks/hero-01'`. Props: badge?, title, description, primaryCta {label, href}, secondaryCta?, className?. Static content — in Astro render server-side (no client directive needed).
